subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly Philippine Airlines from Manila to Shanghai and visit the Starbucks flagship store, then Hangzhou’s West Lake and Leifeng Tower. Ski at Anji’s Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort (ski equipment included), see Wuzhen by night, and spend a full day at Shanghai Disneyland (ticket, transfer and guide included). Includes a free-upgrade Yuyuan hot pot lunch and BBQ dinner. 5-star hotels; a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 6–11 2027 to Feb 19–24 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Starbucks flagship store Shanghai: A large Starbucks Reserve store in Shanghai, visited on the first day.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous lake, a UNESCO World Heritage cultural landscape, strolled along on this tour.
placeDesc.West Lake New World: A modern development by West Lake in Hangzhou, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Leifeng Tower: A pagoda on the shore of West Lake in Hangzhou, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Culture Village: A tea village near West Lake in Hangzhou with a tea tasting and hanfu experience.
placeDesc.Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort: A ski resort in Anji, Zhejiang; ski equipment is included, snow suits are not.
placeDesc.Wuzhen: A well-known canal town in Zhejiang, visited for its night view.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, lined with stores and neon lights.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: The City God Temple business area in old Shanghai, with traditional buildings and shops.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: A full day at the Disney theme park, with ticket, transfer and guide included.
placeDesc.Lujiazui Financial Center: Shanghai's skyscraper district in Pudong, visited via a sky corridor.
